name: @zhushanwen/pi-delivery-port
description: In-process delivery port for the pi half of the unified delivery service (design .tmp/tech-design/unified-delivery.md §3.7): binds pi appendEntry / sessionManager.getEntries / isIdle / sendMessage / message_end / session_compact into the @zhushanwen/session-delivery v3 kernel as the sole executor of the custom lane — outbox journal (entry schema v2 + v1 notify-ledger compat read), details-id delivery proof, session_start difference-set replay, edge-immediate dispatch with external-channel isolation (permanent dedup via the delivery journal), and compaction-wait degradation (shared library, not a Pi extension).
